items.exampleEn: Much of Europe has a temperate climate with four clear seasons.
items.exampleZh: 歐洲大部分地區屬於溫帶氣候，四季分明。

items.exampleEn: This old family photo is priceless to me.
items.exampleZh: 這張老全家福對我來說是無價之寶。

items.exampleEn: The lake looked dreamy in the morning mist.
items.exampleZh: 晨霧中的湖看起來如夢似幻。

items.exampleEn: Iron the shirt to remove the creases.
items.exampleZh: 把襯衫燙一燙，把摺痕燙平。

items.exampleEn: The garden was a wondrous place for children to explore.
items.exampleZh: 那座花園是孩子們探險的奇妙地方。

items.exampleEn: The old hotel is elegantly decorated with paintings and flowers.
items.exampleZh: 那間老飯店以畫作和花卉裝飾得十分優雅。

items.exampleEn: Repeating the same point three times is redundant.
items.exampleZh: 同一個重點講三次是多餘的。

items.exampleEn: His plan to build a boat in the living room was impractical.
items.exampleZh: 他想在客廳裡造船的計畫一點也不實際。

items.sentenceEn: Delete any redundant words to make your essay shorter.
items.sentenceZh: 刪掉多餘的字，讓你的文章短一點。

items.audioEn: The white sofa looks lovely, but it's impractical with two young kids, so we bought a gray one.
items.audioZh: 白色沙發看起來很漂亮，但家裡有兩個小孩不實用，所以我們買了灰色的。

items.sentenceEn: The new tablecloth still had creases from the box.
items.sentenceZh: 新桌巾上還留著盒子壓出的摺痕。

items.sentenceEn: Spring in this valley is mild and temperate.
items.sentenceZh: 這座山谷的春天溫和宜人。

items.stemEn: Some of the old paintings in this museum are so rare that they are ____.
items.stemZh: 這間博物館裡有些古畫稀有到無價。

items.stemEn: She moved so ____ in her long silk dress that she looked like a dancer in a film.
items.stemZh: 她穿著絲質長裙，動作優雅得像電影裡的舞者。

items.passageEn: Every Sunday, my aunt visits the antique market near the old railway station. Last week, she found a wondrous little music box that plays a soft, dreamy tune. The seller said it was priceless, but she paid only a small amount for it. She also saw an exquisite glass table, but it was too heavy and impractical for her small apartment. At home, she found an old letter inside the box, folded with deep creases. She still doesn't know who wrote it.
items.passageZh: 每個星期日，我阿姨都會去舊火車站附近的古董市集。上週，她找到一個奇妙的小音樂盒，會播放輕柔夢幻的旋律。賣家說它是無價之寶，但她只付了一點點錢。她也看到一張精緻的玻璃桌，但對她的小公寓來說太重又不實用。回到家後，她在盒子裡發現一封摺痕很深的舊信。她到現在還不知道是誰寫的。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨為什麼沒買那張玻璃桌？
阿姨在音樂盒裡發現了什麼？

referenceEn: Her essays are always elegantly written.
She writes her essays very elegantly.
rubricZh: 要用 elegantly（例如 elegantly written、writes elegantly 等）
時態合理即可（例如 are、writes 等）

items.promptZh: 公司換了新系統以後，這台舊機器就變得多餘了。
referenceEn: This old machine became redundant after the company got the new system.
Now that the company has a new system, this old machine has become redundant.
rubricZh: redundant 當形容詞「多餘的」（例如 became redundant、has become redundant 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 became、has become 等）
「換了新系統」可寫，例如 got a new system、now that … has a new system 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「她穿得很優雅地去參加晚宴」中文不通順（「穿得很優雅地去」狀語疊用），建議「她穿得很優雅去參加晚宴」或「她打扮得很優雅，去參加晚宴」。
